title: Shared definitions for financial-crime-governance skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (fincrime_risk_rating_enum, sar_decision_enum, sanctions_match_status_enum) sit alongside the base definitions; they show up across cdd-risk-review, sar-decision-qa, and downstream financial-crime artifacts.

severity_enum.description: Standard four-step severity ladder for risks, findings, and program-gap ratings.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by exam-letter ingestion (FinCEN, OCC, FRB, NYDFS Part 504) and audit findings where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'BSA Officer', 'Chief AML Officer', 'Head of Financial Crime', 'Sanctions Officer', 'MLRO'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common financial-crime gates: SAR-filing decision (BSA Officer attestation), CDD risk-rating refresh, EDD escalation, sanctions true-match adjudication. The skill drafts; it does not file.

fincrime_risk_rating_enum.description: CDD / EDD risk rating for a customer relationship. 'prohibited' is used where firm policy forbids the relationship type (e.g., shell banks, certain MSB sub-categories) and routes to exit. 'pending-determination' is used during onboarding before risk-rating completes.

sar_decision_enum.description: SAR decision recorded against an investigation. The skill drafts the rationale; the BSA Officer or named designee makes the final call. Used by sar-decision-qa for second-line review.

sanctions_match_status_enum.description: Disposition for an OFAC / UN / EU / UK sanctions screening hit. 'blocked-pending-license' is used where a hit is a true match but a specific license is being sought.
